method.strict_contiguous: All rolling windows of exactly duration N samples, requiring every adjacent time difference =1 second and all N power samples non-null. Zero watts remain zero. API period curve separately retained. All periods inclusive local dates.
method.indexing: Zero-based start_index and end_index_exclusive; elapsed sample times also retained. A1200-s window spans elapsed1693 through2892 inclusive.
method.scope: Only2026-04-01 through2026-06-01 inclusive, actual athlete warehouse plus authorized API GETs. No tests,fixtures or demo sources.

limitations: One2026-04-14 STRAVA-only record has no accessible detail/duration; known volume is lower bound.
Historical all-out intent not established for each rolling maximum. Even genuine continuous20min336.46W does not by itself establish true FTP or genetic ceiling.

API curve30min295W May27 is not an uninterrupted1800-second window: stricter scan gives best286.99W May23. May27 sample-compressed30min298.21W includes34-second timestamp jump (33 missing seconds). ICU internal handling of that pause and295W curve value not reconstructed.
40min285.20W and60min270.41W May31 are real continuous sampled race windows including freewheeling/variable terrain; they are demonstrated outputs, not upper-bound maximal steady tests.
Historical FTP setting300W and eFTP/PowerManager outputs are different quantities. Do not treat algorithm estimates as measured physiological FTP.
No contemporaneous body mass verified independently; no W/kg ceiling calculated.
Activity names and dated vault sessions establish structured session/race context; not every minute or every ride classified into training zones, no hard-day count inferred from whole-ride IF.
